home.empty-text: A project remembers a database file, and its password if you like, so it opens again in one click.
home.not-database: {{name}} points at a file that is not a DaruDB database. Edit the project to choose another one.
home.open-elsewhere: {{name}} is open in another window, which is now in front.
home.step-create: Create a project and give it a name.
home.step-file: Choose the database file it opens. Any extension works.
home.step-open: Open the project to browse its collections and edit its objects.
home.welcome-text: Browse, edit and query the files of DaruDB, the embedded database for Rust, Node.js, Python and Dart.

project-dialog.delete-copy-text: The project is removed from the list, along with the working copy the app made. The original file stays where it is.
project-dialog.delete-text: The project is removed from the list. The database file stays where it is.
project-dialog.file-error: This file could not be read: {{message}}
project-dialog.file-missing: There is no file at this path any more. Choose another one.
project-dialog.file-ok: A DaruDB database, in format version {{version}}.
project-dialog.file-required: Choose the database file the project opens.
project-dialog.file-upgrade: It is in an older format version. You will be asked how to open it.
project-dialog.name: Project name
project-dialog.no-keystore: This system has no keystore to keep a password in, so you will be asked for it each time.
project-dialog.not-database: This file is not a DaruDB database. Choose another one.
project-dialog.not-encrypted: This file is not encrypted, so it needs no password.
project-dialog.password-hint: Kept encrypted by your system. Leave it empty to be asked each time.
project-dialog.password-kept: A password is saved. Type another one to replace it.
project-dialog.save-failed: The project could not be saved: {{message}}
project-dialog.wrong-password: This password does not open the file.

open-dialog.missing-text: There is nothing at {{path}} any more. The file may have been moved, renamed or deleted.
open-dialog.password-text: The file of {{name}} is encrypted. Type its password to open it.
open-dialog.password-wrong: This password does not open the file.
open-dialog.password-wrong-saved: The saved password no longer opens the file. Type the current one.
open-dialog.upgrade-copy-text: The app copies the file into its own folder and raises the copy. The original stays readable by older versions.
open-dialog.upgrade-original-text: The file itself is raised. Programs on an older version of DaruDB can no longer open it.
open-dialog.upgrade-text: The file of {{name}} is in format version {{from}}. This app opens files in format version {{to}}.

settings.edit-immediate-text: Each edit is written to the file as soon as you make it.
settings.edit-submit-text: Edits wait until you submit them from the toolbar, and can be discarded until then.
settings.title: Settings
